search_text: published ZDI-13-130 ZDI-CAN-1680 Hewlett-Packard Data Protector Cell Manager crs.exe Opcode 211 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2013-06-11 CVE-2013-2333 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2013-2333 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Data Protector'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Data Protector. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within crs.exe which listens by default on a random TCP port. When parsing opcode 211, the process blindly copies user supplied data into a fixed-length stack buffer. A remote attacker can abuse this to execute remote code under the context of the SYSTEM user. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Hewlett-Packard Data Protector Cell Manager crs.exe Opcode 211 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Data Protector. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within crs.exe which listens by default on a random TCP port. When parsing opcode 211, the process blindly copies user supplied data into a fixed-length stack buffer. A remote attacker can abuse this to execute remote code under the context of the SYSTEM user.
